content: Yesu a nawena Paelat be Herod ḡarodie
Dabudine banaga matabudi borue a midisuḡu be Yesu a nawena Paelat ḡarone.

Be dabudi taudi waiwavunama ai karena be a riuna, “Tauma kè vaie da uma baneginama tauna banaga yawai doka waigewedi, be ya riuna da nam sibo Sisa ḡarone ai teks, be mate tauna ya riuna da taunaḡa guyau be Keriso.”
Vutuna aubainama Paelat Yesu yai taravirena, “Tam Jius adi guyau, bo?” Be tauna ya riuna, “Vutuna kwa vatovatona.”
Be Paelat, pirisi adi babadama be patara ya riuedina, “Taugu nam aba gewagewanama uma baneginama ḡarone e banavina.”
Be taudi a riu vavasaḡana, “Tauna Jius nopone na waikatakataima, aubainama banaga nuedima ya sorusoru viviridina. Tauna Galili nopone waikatakatai yai karena da uma dobudine ya tavana.”
Raḡanine Paelat e vaiena be banaga Galili provins a vatovatona, dabudine tauna yai taravidedina, “Tauna Galili provins banegina, bo?”
Be dabudine e vaiena be Yesu Herod na waiguyauma
nopone, naumeki da tauna ya riuporena Herod ḡarone. Baninama inam raḡanine tauna Jerusalemma ya miamiana aubainama.

Raḡanine Herod Yesu ya kitakitana, tauna nuanama ya vere kauana, baninama tauna bonideḡo be ya ḡoeḡoena sibo Yesu ya kitana. Baninama Yesu yaba toitoi yawai tubuḡidina ya vaiena, vutuna aubainama Herod yawai noḡotana Yesu sibo mataira ya voie be tauna ya kitana.
Be Herod giu toitoi Yesu yai taravirevirena, be Yesu nam i paribeena.
Dabudine pirisi adi babadama be tarawatu tauwai katakataidima a midisuḡu be Yesu ai wavu vavasaḡena.
Be Herod na tauiḡarama mate Yesu ai varavara be a raukivi gewagewa kauena. Be Herod gara waimata kanikaninama Yesu yai kote be ya riupore nawe munaḡena Paelat ḡarone.
Inam raḡanine Paelat be Herod ai turana kauana. Be noḡone taudi awai mia taurina.
Paelat ya riuna da Yesu e gurina
Paelat, pirisi adi babadama, babada ḡesaudima be banaga ya rawateḡeidi
be ya riuedina, “Taumi uma baneginama koya verauḡe ḡarogue be koya riuna da tauna banaga ya sorusoru viviridina, be taugu noḡomie è etare be è banavi da taumi ami waiwavuma matabudi nam banidi.
Be teneḡinama Herod nama, be ya riupore munaḡena ḡarode, baninama tauna nam aiyaba i banavina da Yesu sibo ai guri.
Vutuna aubainama taugu yodi tauna yà kovoḡi be yà riupore da e naḡona.”
Be banaga matabudi a rauyogo tenaḡa be a riuna, “Koi guri, be Barabas ko kaiporena tauma ama ḡoanama!”
Be Barabas tauna dibure a boruna, baninama tauna meagai nopone iḡara dosinama yai kare, be banaga yai gurina.
Be Paelat banaga ya riu munaḡedina, baninama tauna ya ḡoeḡoena Yesu sibo ya kaiporena aubainama.
Be taudi Paelat a rauyogoe be a riuriuna, “Kwa tuparatu, kwa tuparatu!”
Be Paelat raḡan wairabuiteḡanama ya riu munaḡedina, “Be uma baneginama aba gewagewanama ya voie? Taugu nam aba e banavina da yài guri! Taugu yà kovoḡi be yà riupore be e naḡona.”
Be taudi a mia rasarasa be a ḡoeḡoena sibo Yesu a tuparatuna korosie. Be taudi yaḡoro a rasarasana.
Dabudine Paelat nuanama ya vitare da banaga adi ḡoanama nama e voiena.

Be tauḡoma meagai nopone iḡara yai kare be banaga yawai gurina, tauna dibure be Paelat ya riupore da ya naḡona, banaga adi ḡoanama ruvane. Be tauna Yesu taudi nimedie ya boru da adi ḡoanama nama a voiena.
Yesu a tuparatuna korosie

Dabudine Yesu ai doka dobiḡe da a nawenawe, be kedae tauḡoma tenaḡa a banavina isanama Saemon, tauna Sairin meagainama tauḡominama. Tauna sipie be ya munamunaḡana meagaie. Naumeki da tauna a vunuḡi be korosi ai kiroḡina, be tauna Yesu ya sagu da korosi ya kiroḡina.
Be patara dosinama tauna murinaḡa a naḡonaḡona, be nopodie waiwaivi mate, be taudi Yesu ai nuaboye be a ḡabaḡabana.
Dabudine Yesu yai tautinamuri be ya riuedina, “Taumi Jerusalem waiwaivimima nam ko ḡabegu, be taumi be ami sedama mate ko ḡaba munaḡemina!
Baninama raḡan ta tavana da taumi ko riuna, ‘Nuavere dosinama waiwaivi kaikaipokidima ḡarodie be aitauḡa nam ti bogana be susudie nam seda ti susurubudina.’
Inam raḡanine banaga oya ta riuedina, ‘Debamaie ko beku da ko dobotawamai!’ Be oya ḡauḡaubodima ta riuedina, ‘Ko ruputawamai!’
Deḡoda taugu kai gidegideviguma ḡarogue nama banaga ta voivoiana, naumeki da banaga maika kai pokidima ḡarodie tokare aba e tubuḡa?”
Be tauiḡaiḡara banaga gewegewedima rabui mate ai doka tenaḡedina waiguridima aubainama.
Raḡanine taudi dobu isanama ‘Debagarere’ dabudi a tavatavana, taudi korosie Yesu a tutuna, be banaga gewegewedima rabui mate. Tenaḡa Yesu kasaunama yauwane be tenaḡa seninama yauwane.
Be Yesu ya riuna, “Mamai kwa noḡota poredi, baninama taudi nam ti kataiena aba ta voivoiena!” Be tauiḡara Yesu na garama a kasiedina.

Be banaga patara dabudine a midi be yaba matabuna a kitekitedina. Be babada Yesu ai kwatekwateve be a riuriuna, “Banaga ḡesaudima yai yawasanidina, be yodi taunaḡa ei yawasana munaḡe deḡoda tauna Keriso, Mamaitua na vinevinema!”
Be tauiḡaiḡara mate waikwatekwatevenama, aubainama taudi waen wairurunama ai tego be a riuna,
“Deḡoda tam Jius adi guyauma, naumeki da kwai yawasana munaḡem!”
Be kai ḡaubonama bogane a girumana raḡan rabuiteḡa, Gurik bonane, Letin bonane be Hibru bonane be a riuna: Uma tauna Jius adi guyauma be korosi bogane a tutuna Yesu debane.
Be gewagewa tauḡominama tenaḡa dabudi ya dawedawena yai diboḡi be ya riuna, “Tam Keriso da kwai yawasanim be kwai yawasanimai!”
Be gewagewa baneginama ḡesaunama turanama ya riutuaḡaie be ya riuna, “Tam wainuatoitoi teneḡinama kwa paḡopaḡona maika Yesu, vutuna aubainama tam Mamaitua sibo kuya vivirena nam kuyai diboḡi,
baninama tauda tà gurina dà gewagewama aubaidima inam naumeki, be tauna nam aba gewagewanama i voiena da sibo ya guri.”
Be dabudine ya riuna, “Yesu tam am waiguyauma nopone kwa saḡasaḡana raḡanine, kwa noḡotiguna.”
Be Yesu ya riuena, “Yà riuriu kauemna da tam manaka taugu mate paradaisie
tà miana.”
Yesu ya gurina

Naumeki be suaratopunama suara ya duba be dobu matabuna yai kupikupina, be nama ya kenana da ravie nama be dobu ya yana munaḡa. Inam raḡanine gara tempol nopone matakeda awai saurina poune ya nuasika poraḡa
da ma nevana a kenana.
Be Yesu bonanama dosine ya riuna, “Mamai, aruiguma nimame yà boruboruna!” Tauna nama ya riuriuna, naumeki da ya gurina.
Dabudine Rom adi badama aba a tubutubuḡana nama ya kitakitana, tauna Mamaitua isanama ya kaisuḡu be ya riuna, “Naumeki riukaua, uma tauna inam didimana baneginama.”
Be banaga matabudi a veraverauna Yesu tuparatunama kitanama aubainama, raḡanine aba ya tubutubuḡana nama a kitekitedina, taudi ai nuaboya kaua be nimedima nuakadedie a biridi be a munaḡana.
Dabudi Yesu na banagama matabudi be waiwaivi Galilima be awai muriwatanena, taudi mate ḡavoe a midi be yaba matabudi a tubutubuḡana a kitekitedina.
Yesu waikokoaginama
Dabudine tauḡoma tenaḡa isanama Jousep. Tauna tenaḡa tauwai tarapiri badanama, be tauna na yawasanama verenama be didimaninama. Be tauna

Mamaitua na waiguyauma ya raberabena da sibo ya tavana. Be inam baneginama tauna na banagama yaba matabudi a giugiuedi be a voivoiedina tauna nam i aninedina. Tauna Jius meagaine, isanama Arimatiama, be ya verauna.
Naumeki be tauna ya naḡona Paelat ḡarone be Yesu tubuḡinama aubainama yai baḡana.
Yodibe ya kiroḡa dobiḡe da garae ya suma be kokoaga guba voivoienama nopone ya boruna, noḡone nam aitau inam kokoagine ti boru rubuna.
Inam raḡaninama vokaukaua na raḡanima, be Sabat raḡaninama ḡaubonaḡa e tava.
Be dabudine waiwaivi aitauḡa Yesu Galili provins nopone ai muriwatane be a veraverauna, taudi Jousep ai muriwatane da kokoagae be nema Yesu tubuḡinama e boru bakena, vutuna kitanama aubainama.
Dabudine waiwaivi a munaḡana vadae da upa be bunama ḡabuḡabudima a vokaukauedina Yesu tubuḡinama aubainama. Be Sabat raḡanine taudi a siperena, adi tarawatuma e riuriuna nama.

footnotes.text: Herod na waiguyauma inam Galili provins nopone be Paelat na waiguyauma inam Judia provins nopone.
Vers 17 inam banaga muriḡa baibol nopone a boru saḡena, noḡone nam i kenakenana. Vers 17 inam umanama: Soi matabuna nopodie Paelat dibura banegidima tenaḡaḡa e kaikaiporaḡana.
‘Paradaisi’ inam banaga aitauḡa Yesu tawai sumaḡe be ta gurigurina, dobudine ta naḡona.

-45 Gara ya nuasikana, vutuna aubainama tauda yodi nam tempol bo pirisi bo musara tà raupuyo Mamaitua ḡarone. Baninama Yesu ya gurina, be yabedima matabudi a kovina. Be yodi tauda didimaninama Mamaitua ḡarone tà naḡo ḡomana.
